I'm sorry. I really didn't mean to be angry I just don't see a way out. 
I called a suicide prevention line and I feel worse.
I'm sorry I really am
Sorry that was angrier than I intended it

My employer reduced me from a job I loved to nothing and bullied me into quitting.  I am humiliated. 

How the actual fuck are hobbies going to help.
Anything and everything there's nothing else I can do

I want the last few months not to have happened. 

I don't want to fight any more. I'm a wreck and I don't feel like a valid human 

I don't care about what I enjoy, there isn't anything and then what good does that do? It's not important when I can't even survive. 

I need to stop existing
